description: Eight-step sequencer — one knob per step, the step chosen by a clock, by a voltage, or by both together

params.text: Addresses a step from 1 to 8; the clocked step and the CV are added to this, wrapping round past eight
The voltage the output carries while that step is the selected one

inputs.text: A trigger restarts the sequence at its first step
A -10V to +10V CV addressing a step, one step per 1.25V, added to the SELECT knob setting

outputs.text: The voltage set by the knob of the step now selected

notes: takes ASX expanders, eight steps each
menu: Polyphony channels from — chooses which input sets the module's channel count, CLOCK input or SELECT input
Reverse step on negative clock — a clock pulse that goes below 0V steps backwards, which the FWD/REV switch then reverses again
Triggered select mode — the SELECT input takes triggers that advance a second sequence whose length the SELECT knob sets, instead of reading a voltage
Wrap select at steps — the select value wraps round at the STEPS setting rather than at the full number of steps
Select on clock mode — the SELECT knob and its CV are read only when a clock pulse arrives, rather than continuously
Range — sets the voltage span the knobs cover: +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V, +/-2V, +/-1V, 0V-10V, 0V-5V, 0V-3V, 0V-2V or 0V-1V
